summary: Senstar Technologies Corporation filed a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026, furnishing its third-quarter 2026 results press release as Exhibit 99.1. Revenue rose 37% year-over-year to a record $13.1 million, GAAP net income was $1.5 million versus $1.0 million a year earlier, and adjusted EBITDA reached $2.1 million, up 55%. Cash and short-term deposits totaled $8.4 million with no debt, down from $22.5 million at year-end 2025. Management cited Blickfeld integration, LiDAR demand, and regional growth; an investor call was scheduled. This is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms apply.
